shared_elements: shallow low-relief carving applied to the broad flat face of the standing stone
arm/limb motif rendered in relief on the shaft below the head/top
justification: Both depict an upright anthropomorphic monolith whose body serves as a field for shallow, schematic low-relief signs, including limb/arm forms and curved looping motifs set below the head/top element, which is a reasonably specific shared scheme. However, A's visible content is a small cluster of arm-and-hook signs on a plain shaft, while B carries a fully modelled head with brow and nose plus a dense symmetrical assemblage of rings, discs and paired motifs across the back, so the specific symbol vocabulary and its organisation differ considerably.
